note: This file is consumed by scripts (render_agent_docs.py, agent_scope.py). Agents should NOT load it directly; all generated content is already inline in CLAUDE.md.

project.name: Chopper
project.summary: ESP32 C++20 embedded astromech firmware. ROS2-inspired pub/sub. Zero-allocation hot path.

hard_rules.rule: Button-to-action mapping belongs in DriveIntentMapping.h / DomeIntentMapping.h, never in action nodes.
hard_rules.why: Mapping is intent-layer logic and must stay out of action nodes.

hard_rules.rule: Never weaken CHECK or REQUIRE assertions to make tests pass.
hard_rules.why: Fix code or the test root cause instead of weakening coverage.

hard_rules.rule: All motor and servo commands must flow through DegradationManager with no bypasses, including transitive ones.
hard_rules.why: Actuator bugs can cause physical harm.

startup_algorithm: Resume checkpoint if one semantically matches the task.
Classify the task mode and match a golden task if one fits.
Load the required persona or personas before the first edit.
Write a plan before editing if the task is cross-cutting, safety-critical, or unclear.
Edit only after scope, placement, and ownership are clear.
Run selective gates based on what changed.
Record a lesson or checkpoint if you found a gap or need to hand off.

minimum_verification.summary: `make test && make format`; if actuator path is reachable, also run `make check-safety`.

verification_rules.skip_when: `test`: another agent ran it, no code changed since. `format`: docs-only or UI-only

verification_rules.what_changed: Telemetry format (TelemetryService, CommonMessages fields, or new command types)

task_modes.scope: Single file, <20 lines, no safety/API/node/topic/limit change
task_modes.preflight: Use .agents/express.md. Skip persona and golden task unless scope expands.

task_modes.scope: Root cause unknown or could originate from multiple stages
task_modes.preflight: Read docs/registry.md, trace pipeline, max 5 tool calls for scoping and 3 for confirmation. No edits.

task_modes.scope: Triage or decomposition with no edits

task_modes.preflight: Use docs persona. Verify cross-references and run make check-docs.
Load telemetry-ui persona and run UI gates.

task_modes.scope: One area, tightly coupled, clear scope
task_modes.preflight: Load the matched persona and state placement reasoning before edit.

task_modes.scope: Motor, servo, safety, or actuator-reachable changes
task_modes.preflight: Safety routing is blocking. Plan before editing.
Load orchestrator and plan sequencing before editing.

semantic_routing.example: Edit PeriscopeNode -> publishes dome/servo_cmd -> reaches ServoBridgeNode
Add a new message type or raise a system limit

notes: Instruction changes have broad implications. Verify cross-references.
Only when no other route matched.

multi_area_rule.note: Load when 3+ personas matched or scope is unclear.

area_definition: An area is a distinct route group from the routes table below. Each route with a unique 'area' field counts as one area. Count distinct areas your touch set hits to classify task mode.

route_rules.multi_match: 2 areas matched: load both personas, work sequentially (safety leads). Still Single-Subsystem or Safety-Critical mode, NOT automatically Cross-Cutting. 3+ areas: load orchestrator (Cross-Cutting mode). Safety (priority 0) is always BLOCKING.

high_impact_files.reason: Wires all subsystems; changes affect every area.
Shared by all nodes; message changes affect downstream consumers.
Fixed-size array caps and capacity budgets are system-wide.

context_budget.small_context_fallback: Use Minimum Viable Instructions + matched persona capsule from cross-tool.md instead of full CLAUDE.md when effective context < 32k tokens.

tiers.name: Express
tiers.behavior: Use .agents/express.md only. Skip persona and golden task.

tiers.name: Focused
tiers.behavior: Startup bundle + target file + golden task if matched.

tiers.name: Cross-Cutting
tiers.behavior: Startup bundle + one additional persona or orchestrator + plan before editing.

entry_points.notes: Bootstrap from AGENTS.md, then use the canonical shell.
Keep editor rules as a thin redirect.
Keep editor rules as a thin redirect.
Use compact fallback blocks plus persona capsules.

capability_degradation.do_this_instead: Use the manual checklist from Constraints plus diff review and call out missing verification.
Stay single-agent and switch roles sequentially.
Use tool-call and file-read thresholds as the context proxy.
Do read-only review and emit file:line findings with severity.
Paste Minimum Viable Instructions and the matched persona capsule.
Use the matched golden task plus persona capsules and touch-set only reads.

context_constrained_mode: Load .agents/express.md plus the matched golden task entry.
Load the matched persona capsule instead of the full persona file.
If safety-relevant, also run the conditional safety gate.
Skip agent-gate-fast unless the golden task or user explicitly requires it.

persona_capsules.name: implementer
lines: Own production-code changes and state placement reasoning before editing.
Escalate to safety-auditor if the change can reach an actuator.
Run lint-embedded for code changes and update docs/registry when interfaces move.

persona_capsules.name: tester
lines: Use doctest for new tests and do not weaken assertions.
Root-cause failures as test bug vs code bug before changing behavior.
Verify Makefile DEPS coverage with make check-test-inventory when adding tests.

persona_capsules.name: safety-auditor
lines: Treat actuator reachability as BLOCKING until safety gating is proven.
Trace commands through DegradationManager and bridge nodes, not comments alone.
Run make check-safety and make check-safety-ordering for safety-relevant diffs.

persona_capsules.name: docs
lines: Source code is authoritative for behavioral and API claims.
Instruction edits must preserve valid cross-references and remove duplicated rules.
Run make check-docs after changing docs, registry, or .agents content.

persona_capsules.name: orchestrator
lines: Single-agent sequential role switching is the default.
Use multi-agent only for disjoint file sets, declared ownership, and explicit merge order.
The orchestrator owns stale-verification detection and final gate execution.

allowed_when: user requests it or the task has 3+ independent phases
merge order and final verifier are assigned
